items.title: Intent-Based Cryptographic API Design for Cryptographic Agility
items.summary: As organizations move toward post-quantum cryptography, they face the major challenge of updating cryptographic algorithms across large, complex software portfolios. However, most cryptographic APIs in use today were designed around specific algorithms. These APIs expect explicit use of specific algorithms, provide little or no support for policy-based algorithm selection, and offer no straightforward way to migrate existing keys to newer algorithms. This makes the transition to post-quantum cryptography challenging. The companion assessment framework identifies the barriers to cryptographic agility and explains why algorithm transition is largely a software engineering problem. To address the limitations of current cryptographic APIs, we identify the principles necessary to design a cryptographically agile API. The design principles are derived from five fundamental architectural characteristics (Abstraction, Stability, Temporal Flexibility, Separation, and Extensibility). We also show how the design principles can be implemented using several examples of Protocol Buffers API design patterns. In particular, we present an intent vocabulary that is based on scopes which allows for decoupling key creation from algorithm identities. It also supports transparent substitutions of algorithms in the applicable scope. Cryptographic governance is enabled by an abstract policy API that does not prescribe the policy format. Keys are represented by stable identifiers and support key evolution operations (rotation, transformation, migration), facilitating migration between algorithms and providers while tracking both the original key identity and its evolution history. With this approach, updating cryptography becomes an operational process without the need to rewrite application code.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着组织向后量子密码学迁移，更新大型复杂软件组合中的密码算法成为重大挑战。当前大多数密码学API围绕特定算法设计，要求显式使用特定算法，对基于策略的算法选择支持不足，并且无法直接将现有密钥迁移至新算法，这阻碍了密码敏捷性的实现。本文首先提出了一个配套评估框架，识别了密码敏捷性的障碍，并指出算法迁移本质上是一个软件工程问题。为解决现有API的局限性，作者从五个基本架构特征（抽象性、稳定性、时间灵活性、分离性、可扩展性）推导出了设计密码敏捷API所需的原则。通过Protocol Buffers API设计模式示例，展示了如何实现这些原则。核心贡献是提出了一个基于作用域（scope）的意图词汇表，使密钥创建与算法身份解耦，并支持在适用作用域内透明替换算法。此外，通过一个不规定策略格式的抽象策略API实现密码治理。密钥由稳定标识符表示，并支持密钥演化操作（轮换、转换、迁移），从而在跟踪原始密钥身份及演化历史的同时，促进算法和提供商之间的迁移。该方法使得密码更新成为操作流程，无需重写应用程序代码。本文适合密码学工程师、软件架构师及安全策略制定者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文提供了实现密码敏捷性的系统化API设计原则与意图驱动的方法，有助于组织更平滑地过渡到后量子密码学，减少因算法变更带来的软件重写成本。

items.title: SoK: The Constant Time Model
items.summary: Constant time programming patterns is the primary defense against timing attacks on cryptographic implementations, yet what "constant time" means varies across academia and industry. This work systematizes constant time models and their evolution, identifies a recurring gap between what models protect and what specifications assume, and distills an offensive methodology for discovering timing vulnerabilities that originate outside the cryptographic primitive boundary. Applying this methodology, we locate a specification-level vulnerability related to private key loading, and confirm the leak in both OpenSSL and BoringSSL. Counterintuitively, BoringSSL's per-observation signal is several orders of magnitude stronger than OpenSSL's, despite an explicitly stricter threat model.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是一篇系统化知识（SoK）论文，聚焦于常时（constant-time）编程模式——当前防范时序攻击的主要防御手段。作者首先梳理了学术界和工业界对“常时”定义的演变与差异，揭示了理论模型与实际规范假设之间的普遍脱节：模型通常保护实现层面的常时属性，但规范层面却可能引入隐含的时序依赖。基于此，作者提炼出一种进攻性方法论，用于发现那些源自密码学原语边界之外的时序漏洞。将该方法应用于私钥加载场景，作者在OpenSSL和BoringSSL中成功确认了一个规范级别的时序泄露：私钥加载过程的某些条件分支依赖于密钥位值，导致可观测的时序差异。BoringSSL尽管采用更严格的威胁模型（假设攻击者能逐条观察指令时序），其每观测信号反而比OpenSSL强出数个数量级，这一反直觉结果凸显了规范与实现之间复杂性。实验通过统计学假设检验（如Welch's t-test）量化泄露程度，并验证了实际可利用性。论文的主要贡献包括：①首次系统化常时模型并分类其演变；②揭示模型-规范间隙；③提出可复用的漏洞挖掘方法论；④在主流TLS库中发现真实漏洞。适合密码学实现者、安全审计人员及时序攻击研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文系统化了常时防御的发展脉络，并揭示了模型与规范之间的关键鸿沟，为发现密码学库中的隐蔽时序漏洞提供了新方法论。实际发现的OpenSSL/BoringSSL私钥加载泄露，直接威胁TLS握手机密性，且BoringSSL的信号强度异常具有反直觉的警示意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响OpenSSL和BoringSSL的相关版本（私钥加载时序泄露），可迁移至其他密码学库（如GnuTLS、Mbed TLS）的类似规范级时序问题。

items.title: Efficient, Robust, and Anti-Collusion Fingerprinting of Image Diffusion Models
items.summary: Model fingerprinting, embedding user-specific identifiers (fingerprints) into generated outputs, has recently emerged as a popular solution to protect the intellectual property rights (IPR) of generative text-to-image (T2I) models and prevent unauthorized redistribution. In this work, we reveal a previously unexplored systematic vulnerability in existing generative model fingerprinting methods: they lack robustness against collusion attacks, where multiple attackers combine their models to remove or obscure the fingerprints. To address this issue, we take the first step towards a robust fingerprinting method for T2I models with anti-collusion capabilities. The proposed method encodes strings of bits, namely fingerprints, into the coefficients of a personalized normalization module (PNM) incorporated into T2I models, so that fingerprints can be reliably recovered from any generated image. To defend against collusion attacks and prevent unauthorized model redistribution, we introduce an anti-collusion mechanism based on lossless function-invariant parameter transformations. This mechanism significantly degrades the image generation quality of colluded models, making them effectively unusable. Moreover, our method allows developers to efficiently create multiple copies of fingerprinted T2I models by reparameterizing the PNM without the need for retraining. We also introduce a worst-case optimization strategy to improve robustness against model-level attacks. Our experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves high fidelity and robustness across multiple T2I image generation and editing tasks, with fingerprint extraction accuracy exceeding 99.5%. Compared with existing methods, our method demonstrates, for the first time, a notable proactive robustness to collusion attacks by significantly increasing the FID of colluded models.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型的指纹嵌入方法展开研究，揭示了现有方法在合谋攻击（collusion attack）下普遍存在的脆弱性：多个攻击者可通过组合各自的模型来移除或混淆指纹，从而规避追踪。为解决此问题，作者首次提出一种兼具鲁棒性和抗合谋能力的指纹方法。核心创新包括：（1）将比特串指纹编码到引入模型中的个性化归一化模块（PNM）的系数中，使任何生成图像都能可靠地提取指纹，提取准确率超过99.5%；（2）提出基于无损函数不变参数变换的抗合谋机制：当多个拥有不同指纹的模型被合并时，该机制会显著降低合谋模型的生成质量（以FID度量），使其几乎不可用，从而阻止非法分发；（3）支持通过重参数化PNM高效创建多个带不同指纹的模型副本，无需重新训练；（4）引入最坏情况优化策略，以增强对模型级攻击的鲁棒性。实验在多种T2I生成和编辑任务上验证了高保真度、高鲁棒性，并在合谋攻击下首次展现出主动防御能力。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 针对扩散模型指纹抗合谋攻击的空白，提出了首个有效的主动防御方案，对保护生成模型知识产权至关重要。

items.title: ViPER: Vision-based Packing-Aware Encoder for Robust Malware Detection
items.summary: Visualization-based malware detection maps raw binary bytes to grayscale images and applies learned visual classifiers, providing an evasion-resistant and disassembly-free alternative to conventional analysis pipelines. However, executable packing remains a critical failure mode: packed binaries produce high-entropy images that obscure the structural patterns these models rely on. Because packing is also prevalent in benign software (e.g., for compression or copy protection), packing state alone is not a reliable indicator of maliciousness, and existing approaches do not address this challenge within a unified supervised framework. We present ViPER, a Vision-based Packing-Aware Encoder for Robust malware detection. ViPER builds on a LoRA-adapted ViT-B/14 backbone with a dual-head architecture that jointly learns malware classification and packing detection. A packing-aware gating mechanism conditions malware predictions on the inferred packing state, enabling distinct decision boundaries for packed and unpacked inputs. To address packing label skew during training, we employ frequency-weighted losses with stratified sampling over joint class-packing strata. Evaluated on 200,000 Windows PE byteplot images, ViPER achieves a balanced accuracy of 0.8521, ROC-AUC of 0.9260, and AUPR of 0.9279, outperforming representative state-of-the-art baselines across all primary metrics, while attaining a packing detection AUC of 0.9949.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为ViPER（基于视觉的加壳感知编码器）的鲁棒恶意软件检测方法。传统的恶意软件检测依赖于反汇编或静态分析，但面对加壳（packing）技术时容易失效。可视化检测方法将二进制文件转换为灰度图像并应用视觉分类器，具有免反汇编和抗规避的优势，但加壳后的二进制会产生高熵图像，混淆分类模型。此外，合法软件也常使用加壳（如压缩或版权保护），因此单纯依靠加壳状态不足以判断恶意性。ViPER基于LoRA（低秩适应）微调的ViT-B/14骨干网络，采用双头架构：一个头用于恶意软件分类，另一个头用于加壳检测。通过加壳感知门控机制，根据推断出的加壳状态调整恶意软件分类的决策边界，使得加壳和未加壳输入分别使用不同的决策规则。为处理训练中加壳标签分布不均的问题，作者设计了频率加权损失函数，并结合联合类别-加壳分层采样。在20万张Windows PE字节图图像上评估，ViPER的平衡准确率为0.8521，ROC-AUC为0.9260，AUPR为0.9279，均优于多个代表性基线模型；同时加壳检测AUC达到0.9949。该工作为鲁棒的恶意软件检测提供了新思路，尤其适用于对抗加壳混淆的场景。适合安全研究员和恶意软件分析师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 加壳是恶意软件常用的逃避检测手段，而现有可视化检测方法对加壳样本脆弱。ViPER在统一框架中同时学习加壳检测和恶意分类，显著提升鲁棒性，对实际安全运营中的恶意软件检测有重要参考价值。

items.title: MAStrike: Shapley-Guided Collusive Red-Teaming on Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: Hierarchical multi-agent systems (MAS) are rapidly being deployed in high-stakes workflows across domains such as finance and software engineering. In these systems, safety and security are inherently distributed across role-specialized agents, significantly expanding the attack surface, particularly under coordinated adversarial behaviors such as privilege escalation and cross-agent collusion. Existing red-teaming approaches for MAS remain limited: they rely on heuristic selection of target agents and perturb isolated message streams, leaving critical questions unanswered as which agents are most responsible for system safety, and how compromised agents can coordinate to bypass defenses. We propose MAStrike, a closed-loop framework for collusive red-teaming in hierarchical MAS. We propose the first agent-level Shapley value analysis for MAS, quantifying each agent's marginal contribution to system robustness under task-specific distributions. GGuided by this attribution, MAStrike identifies vulnerable agent coalitions and generates coordinated, role-aware adversarial manipulations. These attacks are iteratively refined through structured causal diagnosis, attributing failure cases to uncompromised agents that block adversarial attempts. We further build a comprehensive MAS red-teaming benchmark and controllable environments spanning diverse hierarchical topologies and domains, including finance, software engineering, and CRM. Extensive experiments across MAS built on multiple frontier models show that MAStrike substantially outperforms heuristic baselines. Our analysis further uncovers non-trivial Shapley value distributions and higher-order interaction structures among agents, revealing critical vulnerabilities and coordination patterns that are overlooked by prior single-agent or template-based methods.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出MAStrike，一个针对层次化多智能体系统（MAS）的协同红队测试框架。MAS正被快速部署于金融、软件工程等高价值工作流中，但其安全依赖分布式角色，攻击面显著扩大，尤其是权限提升和跨智能体协同等对抗行为。现有红队方法局限于启发式选择目标智能体和扰动孤立消息流，未能回答哪些智能体对系统安全最负责以及受损智能体如何协同绕过防御。MAStrike首次引入基于Shapley值的代理级归因分析，量化每个智能体在任务特定分布下对系统鲁棒性的边际贡献；据此识别易受攻击的智能体联盟，并生成协调的、角色感知的对抗操纵。攻击通过结构化因果诊断进行迭代优化，将失败案例归因于阻止对抗尝试的未受损智能体。此外，作者构建了全面的MAS红队基准和可控环境，覆盖金融、软件工程、CRM等多个领域和不同层次拓扑。基于多种前沿模型的大量实验表明，MAStrike显著优于启发式基线，揭示了非平凡的Shapley值分布和智能体间高阶交互结构，发现被先前单智能体或模板方法忽视的关键漏洞和协同模式。本文贡献在于提出首个协同红队闭环方法、通用归因框架及基准，适合多智能体系统安全研究人员和开发者阅读。

items.title: PolicyGuard: Towards Test-time and Step-level Adversary Defense for Reinforcement Learning Agent
items.summary: While real-world applications of reinforcement learning (RL) are becoming increasingly popular, the security of RL systems deserve more attention and exploration. In particular, recent work has revealed that RL agents are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where a victim agent behaves normally under standard conditions but executes malicious actions when a specific trigger is activated. Existing backdoor defenses for RL either require access to the agent's internal parameters, operate only at the model or trajectory level, or are limited to specific attack types. To ensure the security of RL agents, we propose \texttt{PolicyGuard}, a \textit{test-time step-level} backdoor defense which leverages Gaussian Process (GP) posterior variance and adapts pseudo trajectories to enable uncertainty computation for individual time step. Besides, we also provide theoretical foundations to explain the efficacy of GP posterior variance. Extensive experiments across seven RL games demonstrate that PolicyGuard achieves state-of-the-art detection performance in most cases, with average AUROC of 0.856 for perturbation-based attacks and 0.859 for adversary-agent attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注强化学习（RL）系统的安全性，特别是后门攻击的防御问题。后门攻击下，受感染的RL智能体在正常环境中表现正常，但遇到特定触发器时会执行恶意动作。现有防御方法存在局限：要么需要访问智能体内部参数，要么仅在模型或轨迹层面操作，要么只能防御特定攻击类型。为此，作者提出	exttt{PolicyGuard}，一种	extit{测试时步骤级}后门防御方法。核心创新在于利用高斯过程（GP）后验方差，并引入自适应伪轨迹技术，使得能够计算单个时间步的不确定性，从而实现步骤级的异常检测。此外，论文从理论上解释了GP后验方差有效性的原因。实验在七个RL游戏（如Atari等）上进行，结果表明PolicyGuard在大多数情况下达到SOTA检测性能：对基于扰动的攻击平均AUROC为0.856，对对抗智能体攻击平均AUROC为0.859。该方法不要求修改训练过程，可直接用于已部署的智能体，具有实际应用价值。适合RL安全研究人员、AI系统防御工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次提出测试时步骤级后门防御，无需内部参数即可在单步粒度检测攻击，填补了RL安全的关键空白。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至自动驾驶、游戏AI、机器人控制等RL应用场景，提升对抗攻击场景下的安全性。

items.title: LNTest: A Testbed for Evaluating Bitcoin Lightning Network-Based Botnets
items.summary: Bitcoin's Lightning Network (LN) can be exploited as a covert, low-cost command-and-control (C&C) channel for botnets, as demonstrated by the LNBot and D-LNBot designs. However, both remain proof-of-concept prototypes evaluated only through simulation, leaving key questions about real-world topology formation, propagation complexity, and resilience to takedowns unanswered. We present LNTest, the first reusable testbed for LN-based botnets, built from Core Lightning nodes containerized with Docker over a shared Bitcoin Core regtest chain. LNTest supports three overlay topology modes (a deterministic chain, autonomous peer discovery, and user-supplied graphs), enabling controlled experiments across different botnet structures. Using LNTest, we report three main findings. First, D-LNBot's autonomous formation protocol does not produce the uniform chain from its design; instead, it creates a clustered chain in which cliques are linked by bridge nodes whose removal fragments the network. Second, command propagation scales linearly with botnet size ($Θ(n)$), not the $O(m \log n)$ previously claimed, and gains nothing from higher neighbor connectivity. Third, the overlay topology determines the effectiveness of takedown strategies: uniform-degree chains resist targeted removal but fragment under random failure, scale-free topologies show the opposite pattern, and the autonomous clustered chain is fragile under both, making it the most vulnerable of the three. LNTest is released as open source, with a script that reproduces all our experiments, to support reproducible research on LN-based botnet defenses.
authors: Jesus Maria Romo Diaz de Leon

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 LNTest，一个用于评估基于比特币闪电网络（LN）的僵尸网络的测试平台。LN 由于低费用和强隐私性，可被利用作为隐蔽、低成本的命令与控制（C&C）信道。此前提出的 LNBot 和 D-LNBot 设计仅是概念验证，仅通过仿真评估，缺乏对真实世界拓扑形成、传播复杂性和抗拆除能力的理解。LNTest 基于 Core Lightning 节点和 Docker 容器化构建，在共享的 Bitcoin Core regtest 链上运行，支持三种覆盖拓扑模式：确定性链、自主对等发现和用户提供图。利用 LNTest，作者取得三项主要发现：第一，D-LNBot 的自主形成协议并未产生设计中的均匀链，而是生成聚类链（clustered chain），其中簇通过桥接节点连接，移除桥接节点会导致网络分裂；第二，命令传播规模线性增长（Θ(n)），而非先前声称的 O(m log n)，更高的邻居连接度并未带来增益；第三，覆盖拓扑决定拆除策略效果：均匀度链抵抗针对性移除但易受随机故障影响，无标度拓扑呈现相反模式，而自主聚类链在两种策略下都脆弱，是最易受攻击的结构。LNTest 已开源，附带可复现所有实验的脚本，支持可重复的 LN 僵尸网络防御研究。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 比特币闪电网络作为新兴支付通道，其隐蔽性和低成本特性可能被攻击者利用构建新型 C&C 信道，传统僵尸网络检测手段难以覆盖。LNTest 提供了首个可复用的测试环境，帮助安全从业者实证评估此类威胁，并揭示了关键设计缺陷与拓扑脆弱性，对开发针对性检测和防御策略有重要指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响基于闪电网络的僵尸网络研究与防御实践，可迁移至其他基于 P2P 网络或区块链的隐蔽信道评估场景。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，将 LNTest 纳入内部威胁建模与评估工具链，关注后续防御技术发展。

items.title: Semantic Identification of IoT Devices from Behavioral Primitives
items.summary: Accurate identification of IoT devices is important for security management and policy enforcement. Existing approaches typically learn device signatures from packets or flow records. These methods operate on low-level communication observations whose traffic patterns may vary across deployments, software versions, and user interactions. This paper studies device identification using Manufacturer Usage Description (MUD) profiles. MUD profiles describe device behavior using Access Control Entries (ACEs), where each ACE represents a behavioral primitive consisting of protocol, endpoint, direction, and port semantics derived from device communication policy. Our contributions are threefold. First, using 28 publicly available MUD profiles containing 1,023 ACE instances, we construct ACE-level semantic representations from compact behavioral text and analyze their geometric properties. ACE-level representations preserve device-level behavioral distinctions more effectively than whole-profile embeddings and remain effective after whitening calibration. Second, we evaluate semantic ACE matching under controlled runtime variations, including unseen ACEs, drifted hostnames, and partial runtime observation. Exact ACE matching performs well when the overlap with the canonical MUD profile remains high, but degrades sharply when the overlap becomes sparse or disappears. In contrast, semantic ACE matching preserves useful identification evidence across these conditions. Third, we evaluate the same approach on real IoT traffic traces comprising more than 800,000 observed flows. Exact overlap remains the strongest signal when stable overlap exists, while semantic ACE matching provides stronger identification evidence during the early stages of observation, frequently retains the correct device among the highest-ranked candidates, and remains effective under sparse-overlap runtime traffic.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于行为原语的物联网设备语义识别方法。传统方法通常依赖数据包或流记录学习设备签名，但这些低层通信特征可能因部署环境、软件版本和用户交互而变化。作者利用制造商使用描述（MUD）文件，该文件通过访问控制条目（ACE）描述设备行为，每个ACE包含协议、端点、方向和端口等语义信息。论文主要贡献有三点：第一，使用28个公开MUD文件（包含1023个ACE实例）构建ACE级别的语义表示，通过紧凑的行为文本生成嵌入，并分析其几何属性。研究表明，ACE级表示比整个MUD配置文件嵌入更能保留设备级行为区分度，且经白化校准后仍有效。第二，在可控运行时变化下评估语义ACE匹配，包括未见过的ACE、漂移的主机名和部分运行时观察。精确ACE匹配在规范MUD重叠度高时表现良好，但重叠稀疏或消失时性能急剧下降；而语义ACE匹配能在各种条件下保留有用的识别证据。第三，在包含80万条流的真实IoT流量轨迹上评估，发现精确重叠仍是强信号，但语义ACE匹配在观察初期提供更强识别证据，常将正确设备保留在最高候选排名中，且在稀疏重叠的运行时流量下仍然有效。该方法适用于安全管理和策略执行中的设备识别。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了一种不依赖低层流量模式的新型IoT设备识别方法，可应对网络部署变化和用户交互导致的签名漂移，对安全策略自动化执行有参考价值。

items.title: Fed-FBD: Federated Functional Block Diversification for Isolation, Privacy, and Surgical Unlearning
items.summary: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without sharing raw patient data, but standard approaches such as FedAvg treat each client as a black box and provide no mechanism for isolating an adversarial contributor, auditing per-client influence, or honoring a departed participant's right to be forgotten. We present Fed-FBD (Federated Functional Block Diversification), a modular federated architecture that decomposes a ResNet backbone into six functional blocks (the stem, four residual groups, and the classification head) and maintains a warehouse of N color variants, each assembled from independently tracked and contributor-stamped blocks. Fed-FBD provides three capabilities absent in FedAvg: (i) architecturally guaranteed block-level isolation, so that an adversarial or mislabelled client cannot contaminate the clean colous; (ii) privacy-by-design, where membership inference advantage is already indistinguishable from chance before any privacy mechanism is applied; and (iii) surgical machine unlearning of a departed participant's contribution at sub-second cost and without retraining. Experiments on six MedMNIST-2D datasets, PathMNIST at 224x224, and CIFAR-10 show that Fed-FBD trades a modest 0.3%-3.1% IID accuracy gap on the adequately sized datasets for these guarantees, remains within 0.8%-4.0% of FedAvg at Dirichlet alpha=1.0 on three of four datasets, and confines all six adversarial attacks we study to the poisoned client's own blocks with at most +/-0.01 AUC drift on the clean colors.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 联邦学习（FL）允许多方协作训练模型而无需共享原始数据，但现有方法如FedAvg将每个客户端视为黑箱，无法隔离恶意贡献者、审计每客户端影响或满足已被遗忘权。本文提出Fed-FBD（联邦功能块多样性），一种模块化联邦架构，将ResNet骨干网络分解为六个功能块（主干、四个残差组和分类头），并维护一个由独立追踪且带有贡献者印记的块组装而成的N个颜色变体仓库。Fed-FBD提供了FedAvg所不具备的三种能力：(i) 架构保证的块级隔离，使恶意或标签错误的客户端无法污染清洁颜色；(ii) 隐私设计，即在应用任何隐私机制之前，成员推断优势已无法与随机区分；(iii) 在亚秒级成本下无需重新训练即可手术式遗忘已退出参与者的贡献。在六个MedMNIST-2D数据集、224x224的PathMNIST和CIFAR-10上的实验表明，在足够大小的数据集上，Fed-FBD相对于FedAvg在IID精度上仅折损0.3%-3.1%即可获得这些保证；在四个数据集中的三个上，Dirichlet alpha=1.0时与FedAvg的差距在0.8%-4.0%以内；并且将我们研究的所有六种对抗攻击限制在恶意客户端自身的块内，清洁颜色的AUC漂移最多为+/-0.01。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作首次在联邦学习中实现了高效的块级隔离和手术式遗忘，兼顾隐私与模型效用，对医疗等敏感场景的联邦学习部署具有重要参考价值。

items.title: CAPED: Context-Aware Privacy Exposure Defense for Mobile GUI Agents
items.summary: Screenshot-based mobile GUI agents can operate ordinary smartphone apps through the same visual interface as a human user, but this capability also turns every screen observation into a privacy boundary. During normal task execution, screenshots may expose contacts, messages, photos, files, recommendations, health cues, and other sensitive context that is unrelated to the user's request. We call this problem incidental visual privacy exposure. It is difficult to address with existing defenses: text anonymization misses many visual and inferential cues, while generic privacy masking can remove the evidence and controls that a GUI agent needs to complete the task. This paper presents CAPED, a context-aware pre-upload exposure control layer for mobile GUI agents. CAPED is designed as a phone-side protection layer: before screenshots are released to a remote multimodal agent, it extracts task requirements, uses screen context as a privacy prior, parses visible UI elements, and selectively exposes only content needed for the current task while masking incidental private content. We evaluate CAPED on AndroidWorld for broad task utility and with a controlled 28-task seeded privacy evaluation used as a measurement instrument for trajectory-level incidental leakage. In this seeded evaluation, Full CAPED reduces success-conditioned weighted seeded leakage from 0.766 under raw screenshots to 0.268 while preserving high task utility. A broader AndroidWorld run shows a remaining prototype-level utility cost, but the results support the central claim that screenshot upload should be treated as an explicit device--cloud boundary decision, governed by task-driven selective exposure rather than all-or-nothing screen sharing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了基于截图的移动GUI代理（如多模态大模型驱动的手机操控智能体）在执行用户任务时遇到的“附带性视觉隐私暴露”问题。这类代理通过观察屏幕截图来操作应用，但截图可能包含与任务无关的敏感信息（如联系人、消息、照片、健康数据等），构成隐私边界。现有防御手段如文本匿名化无法处理视觉推理线索，通用隐私遮挡又会破坏代理完成任务所需的证据和控件。为此，作者提出CAPED（上下文感知预上传曝光控制层），作为手机端保护层，在截图发送给远程多模态代理之前，提取任务需求、利用屏幕上下文作为隐私先验、解析可见UI元素，仅暴露当前任务所需内容，遮挡无关隐私。论文在AndroidWorld上进行任务效用评估，并设计了一个包含28个任务的种子隐私评估实验来度量轨迹级附带泄露。实验表明，完整CAPED将加权种子泄露从原始截图的0.766降至0.268，同时保持高任务效用。更广泛的AndroidWorld测试显示存在原型级别的效用代价，但结果支持核心主张：截图上传应作为显式的设备-云端边界决策，由任务驱动的选择性曝光而非全有或全无的屏幕共享来管理。本文适合移动安全、AI agent隐私防护领域的研究者和工程师阅读。

items.title: Amnesia: A Stealthy Replay Attack on Continual Learning Dreams
items.summary: Continual learning (CL) models often use experience replay to reduce catastrophic forgetting, but their robustness to replay sampling interference remains underexplored. Existing CL attacks alter inputs or training pipelines (poisoning/backdoors) and rarely include explicit auditable constraints, limiting realism. Here, auditability means a monitor can verify compliance from sampler-visible telemetry - e.g., logged replay index/label statistics - by checking that the realized replay class histogram stays close to a nominal baseline and that replay rate is unchanged per batch and/or over a rolling window. We study a limited-privilege insider who controls only replay index selection, not pixels, labels, or model parameters, while staying within auditable limits such as queue priorities. We introduce Amnesia, a replay composition attack that maximizes degradation under two budgets: a visibility budget delta bounding the TV/KL divergence from a nominal class histogram p0, and a mass budget f fixing the replay rate. Amnesia has two steps: (i) compute lightweight class utilities, such as EMA loss or confidence, to tilt p0 toward harmful classes; and (ii) project the tilt back into the delta-ball using efficient KL (exponential tilt) or TV (balanced mass redistribution) optimizers. A windowed scheduler enforces rolling audits. Across challenging CL benchmarks and strong replay baselines, Amnesia consistently lowers final accuracy (ACC) and worsens backward transfer (-BWT). The KL variant delivers high impact while remaining largely undetected under multiple audit schemes, including per-batch and rolling-window checks. The TV variant is more damaging but easier to detect, especially under tight per-class constraints. These results expose index-only replay control as a practical, auditable threat surface in CL systems and establish a principled impact-visibility trade-off.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 持续学习模型常使用经验重放来缓解灾难性遗忘，但重放采样干扰的鲁棒性研究不足。现有攻击修改输入或训练流程（投毒/后门），且很少包含显式的可审计约束，限制了现实性。本文研究具有有限权限的内部攻击者，只能控制重放索引选择（不能修改像素、标签或模型参数），同时保持在可审计限度内（如队列优先级）。作者提出 Amnesia，一种重放组成攻击，在两种预算下最大化退化：可见性预算 delta（限制名义类直方图 p0 的 TV/KL 散度）和质量预算 f（固定重放率）。Amnesia 两步： (i) 计算轻量级类效用（如 EMA 损失或置信度），将 p0 朝有害类倾斜； (ii) 使用高效 KL（指数倾斜）或 TV（平衡质量再分布）优化器将倾斜投影回 delta-ball。窗口调度器强制执行滚动审计。在具有挑战性的 CL 基准和强重放基线上，Amnesia 持续降低最终准确率 (ACC) 并恶化后向迁移 (BWT)。KL 变体在多种审计方案（包括每批次和滚动窗口检查）下影响大且难以检测；TV 变体破坏性更强但易检测，尤其在严格每类约束下。这些结果揭示了仅索引重放控制是 CL 系统中一个实际、可审计的威胁面，并建立了原则性的影响-可见性权衡。

items.title: Beyond Attack Success Rate: Examining Trigger Leakage in Vision-Language Agentic Systems
items.summary: Vision-Language Agentic Systems (VLAS) connect visual perception to planning, tool use, and physical actions. This means backdoor-type triggers can propagate through both decision pipelines and their connected interfaces, thus making visual backdoors a system-level threat. Current evaluations on such backdoors focus on clean accuracy and attack success rate (ASR), metrics that capture whether a trigger works, but not whether an attack is actually "precise" -- i.e. whether it triggers hidden behaviors only when intended. In this work, we formalize the failure of trigger precision as "trigger leakage": inputs that are visually or semantically close to the intended trigger and therefore inadvertently activate the attacker-specified behavior. To quantify this leakage, we introduce Neighbor Leakage Rate (NLR). Our experiments show that at a 3% poisoning ratio, icon and text triggers remain robust to common visual transformations, but their neighboring variants leak heavily, with NLR reaching 0.996 (icon) and 0.944 (text). Using textual triggers as a controlled probe, we show that standard fine-tuning learns a broad activation region rather than an exact trigger condition, causing neighboring strings to invoke the malicious behavior even when the exact trigger is absent. Adding edit-distance-one hard-negative samples during training substantially narrows this activation region and reduces leakage, including in image-editing and embodied-manipulation workflows, where leaked triggers can propagate into executable programs and action sequences.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了视觉-语言智能体系统（VLAS）中的后门攻击新问题——触发泄露（Trigger Leakage）。VLAS将视觉感知与规划、工具使用及物理动作连接起来，使得后门触发器不仅影响决策流程，还能通过接口传播，构成系统级威胁。现有评估仅关注干净准确率和攻击成功率（ASR），无法衡量攻击的精确性。作者定义触发泄露为：与预期触发器在视觉或语义上相近的输入无意中激活了攻击者指定的隐藏行为。为量化泄露，提出相邻泄露率（Neighbor Leakage Rate, NLR）。实验在3%投毒比例下，图标和文本触发器对常见视觉变换保持鲁棒，但邻近变体泄露严重，图标NLR达0.996，文本NLR达0.944。通过文本触发器作为受控探针，发现标准微调学习的是宽激活区域而非精确触发条件，导致邻近字符串即使不含精确触发器也能调用恶意行为。在训练中加入编辑距离为1的硬负样本能显著缩小激活区域、降低泄露，并在图像编辑和具身操作工作流中验证了效果，其中泄露触发器可传播至可执行程序和动作序列。本文首次系统化量化了VLAS中后门触发的不精确性，为设计更安全的智能体系统提供了新视角。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次揭示VLAS后门攻击的触发泄露问题，指出传统ASR指标的不足，对设计高精度安全触发器检测机制具有指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响视觉-语言智能体系统（如自主机器人、图像编辑工具）的安全部署，尤其涉及触发器通过决策管道传播至物理动作的场景。

items.title: MARCIM-WG: A cyber wargame proposal based on math modeling applied in a naval scenario
items.summary: As maritime operations increasingly depend on interconnected digital ecosystems, cyber incidents can propagate across maritime networks and degrade critical services. Strengthening strategic Cyber Situational Awareness (CSA) therefore requires training mechanisms that expose decision-makers to evolving attack dynamics, constrained resources, and the need to align actions with incident-response procedures. This paper introduces MARCIM-WG, a learning-oriented maritime cyberdefense wargame designed following the NATO wargaming methodology and implemented as a hybrid tabletop experience combining a physical board (tokens, indicators, and special cards) with analytically-assisted adjudication supported by a computational simulation model. The proposal is specified through High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD) specifications and instantiated in a fictional maritime cyber crisis scenario to enable structured decision cycles, friction, and measurable consequences. Validation combines (i) an operational scenario-based assessment under three configurations (pessimistic, neutral/most likely, optimistic) to verify decision sensitivity and outcome coherence, and (ii) a CSA competency and learning-outcome evaluation using a comparative design against an equivalent control group. Results show a +34.0 percentage-point improvement in the intervention group, with the largest gains in comprehension-related competencies.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 MARCIM-WG，一个面向海上网络防御的学习型网络战争游戏。随着海上作战越来越依赖互联的数字生态系统，网络事件可能在海事网络中传播并降低关键服务的可用性。为了提升战略网络态势感知能力，决策者需要接受训练，以应对动态攻击、资源约束以及与事件响应程序对齐的压力。MARCIM-WG 遵循北约战争游戏方法论设计，采用混合桌面体验：结合物理棋盘（令牌、指示器和特殊卡牌）与分析辅助裁决（由计算模拟模型支持）。游戏通过高层设计（HLD）和低层设计（LLD）规格详细说明，并在一个虚构的海上网络危机场景中实例化，以提供结构化的决策周期、摩擦和可衡量的后果。验证包含两部分：(i) 基于操作场景的评估，在三种配置（悲观、中性/最可能、乐观）下验证决策灵敏度和结果一致性；(ii) 通过与等效对照组比较，评估 CSA 能力和学习成果。结果显示干预组提升了 34.0 个百分点，尤其在理解相关能力上提升最大。该游戏旨在训练海军指挥官和网络防御人员在复杂、受限环境中的决策能力，可推广至其他关键基础设施领域的网络防御训练。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为海上网络防御训练提供了创新的、经过验证的战争游戏框架，显著提升了决策者的网络态势感知能力，对提升关键基础设施韧性具有直接价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至其他行业（如能源、交通）的网络防御训练场景，帮助组织设计类似的模拟训练方案。

items.title: Partitioned Tags, Shared Data: Reconciling Strict Cache Isolation with Write-Shared Coherence
items.summary: Cache partitioning is among the strongest structural defenses against eviction-based cache side channels, yet a decade-old design issue has blocked its widespread deployment in secure shared-OS settings. The issue is that write-shared coherence collapses under strict partitioning. We present SCP (Secure and Coherent Partitioning), which combines strict eviction isolation with write-shared coherence by partitioning only the tags, sharing a single data pool, and sizing the data pool so capacity-driven cross-partition eviction cannot occur. Timing obfuscation extends protections to the inter-partition lookup path. Coherence-based leakage on shared-writeable lines is mitigated by routing those writes through to the LLC once a leakage threshold is crossed, which makes attacker write probe latency independent of victim activity. Using gem5 for implementation, SCP mitigates Prime+Probe and Flush+Reload, which are the basis for more sophisticated cache attacks. We also demonstrate that a shared-writeable-line attack is mitigated. All these attacks yield results no better than random guessing. SCP's hardware cost is a modest +2.8% LLC SRAM. Performance matches DAWG within 0.3% IPC on the SPEC CPU2017 benchmarks that we evaluated. Sharing-intensive microbenchmarks demonstrate a tunable security-performance tradeoff based on a system-specified leakage threshold.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出SCP（安全且一致的缓存分区）方法，旨在解决缓存分区技术在共享操作系统环境中因写共享缓存一致性协议导致的安全缺陷。传统严格分区技术无法支持写共享一致性，而SCP通过仅分区标签、共享单一数据池，并合理调整数据池大小以避免容量驱动的跨分区驱逐，同时结合时序混淆保护跨分区查找路径。针对写共享行的缓存一致性泄漏，SCP在泄漏阈值超过后将这些写操作路由至最后一级缓存（LLC），使攻击者写探测延迟与受害者活动无关。基于gem5模拟器实现，SCP证明了其对Prime+Probe、Flush+Reload以及写共享行攻击的有效防御，所有攻击结果均不优于随机猜测。硬件开销仅为LLC SRAM增加2.8%，在SPEC CPU2017基准测试中性能与DAWG相当（IPC相差0.3%以内）。共享密集型微基准测试显示可调的安全-性能权衡。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 缓存侧信道攻击是云环境中的严重威胁，SCP在保持缓存分区强隔离的同时，首次实现了写共享一致性，解决了长期困扰安全操作系统的设计难题，为下一代安全硬件缓存设计提供了可行方案。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对云服务提供者、操作系统安全研究者、处理器架构设计者具有直接参考价值，可应用于安全虚拟机监控器、可信执行环境等场景。

items.title: Reinforcement Learning Disrupts Gradient-Based Adversarial Optimization
items.summary: Gradient-based adversarial attacks remain a dominant threat to deep neural networks (DNNs), as they exploit gradient information to efficiently optimize adversarial perturbations. To address this, we investigate whether reinforcement learning (RL) training can disrupt the gradient structure used by attackers by training image classifiers with policy-gradient objectives and epsilon-greedy exploration. Through systematic experiments across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet-100 with multiple architectures, we find that RL-trained classifiers significantly disrupt gradient-based adversarial optimization. To explain this, we conduct a comprehensive mechanism analysis using loss landscape visualization, static and dynamic gradient indicators, and predictive entropy. Our analysis reveals that RL acts as an implicit regularizer, producing models with highly unstable gradient directions and smaller gradient magnitudes. This combination makes each PGD step both unreliable in direction and limited in magnitude, causing gradient-based attacks to fail within practical iteration budgets. We further show that combining RL with adversarial training (RL-adv) provides a dual-layer defense operating at two complementary levels: RL degrades gradient information available to attackers (gradient-level defense), while adversarial training strengthens decision boundaries (boundary-level defense). RL-adv achieves the highest robustness across all major attack types evaluated, including gradient-based (PGD, AutoAttack), transfer-based, and query-based attacks, outperforming SL-adv by a significant margin. These findings identify RL-induced gradient disruption as a complementary robustness mechanism and motivate future research on hybrid SL-RL training schedules that combine SL's efficiency with RL's gradient-regularization properties.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文研究强化学习（RL）训练对基于梯度的对抗攻击的防御效果。传统的梯度攻击（如PGD）利用模型梯度信息高效生成对抗样本，对深度神经网络构成严重威胁。作者提出使用策略梯度和ε-贪婪探索训练图像分类器，并在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet-100数据集上使用多种架构进行系统实验。结果表明，RL训练的分类器显著阻碍了基于梯度的对抗优化。为了解释这一现象，作者通过损失景观可视化、静态和动态梯度指标以及预测熵进行了全面的机制分析。分析揭示，RL作为一种隐式正则化器，使得模型梯度方向高度不稳定且幅值变小。这种组合导致每次PGD迭代的方向不可靠且步长受限，从而使梯度攻击在有限的迭代预算内失效。进一步，作者将RL与对抗训练结合（RL-adv），形成双层防御：RL在梯度层面削弱攻击者可利用的梯度信息（梯度级防御），而对抗训练则强化决策边界（边界级防御）。RL-adv在包括基于梯度（PGD、AutoAttack）、基于迁移和基于查询的各类主要攻击下均取得了最高鲁棒性，显著优于单独使用对抗训练的模型。该研究识别了RL诱导的梯度破坏作为一种互补的鲁棒性机制，并启发未来探索混合监督学习和强化学习训练策略，以结合SL的高效性和RL的梯度正则化特性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提出利用强化学习本身特性作为对抗防御的新范式，并非依赖额外样本或网络修改，可与对抗训练叠加增强鲁棒性，为低计算成本的防御提供新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于图像分类等感知任务的对抗防御，尤其需要应对多种攻击类型的场景，可延伸到其他基于梯度的模型。

items.title: Bridging the Smart City Cybersecurity Data Gap Through AI-Driven Synthetic Dataset Generation
items.summary: Smart cities rely on interconnected cyber-physical systems that integrate sensors, IoT devices, cloud platforms, and AI-driven services and decision-making. While these systems enhance city services, they also introduce complex cybersecurity challenges due to their large attack surfaces, heterogeneous data flows, and evolving threat vectors. Developing and validating cybersecurity tools for smart cities requires high-quality datasets that accurately represent real operational conditions. However, real-world datasets are often incomplete, contain privacy-sensitive data, are difficult to access, or lack sufficient malicious activity to support tool development. This research addresses this critical gap by proposing an AI-based synthetic data generation (SDG) framework designed specifically for smart city cybersecurity research. The proposed framework leverages generative artificial intelligence models to produce high-fidelity synthetic cybersecurity datasets that replicate realistic device behaviors, network interactions, and cyber-attack scenarios. The synthetic datasets are evaluated for conformity to protocol standards, statistical similarity to original datasets, and utility in common security tools. The resulting synthetic data generation framework and evaluation metrics are expected to advance smart city cybersecurity by enabling researchers to model threats more effectively and evaluate defensive techniques more comprehensively to better protect critical smart city infrastructures.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对智慧城市网络安全研究中高质量数据集稀缺的问题，提出了一种基于AI的合成数据生成（SDG）框架。智慧城市依赖于集成了传感器、物联网设备、云平台和AI驱动服务的网络物理系统，这些系统虽然提升了城市服务效率，但也因巨大的攻击面、异构数据流和不断演变的威胁向量而引入了复杂的网络安全挑战。开发和验证智慧城市网络安全工具需要能够准确反映实际运行条件的高质量数据集。然而，真实世界的数据集往往不完整、包含隐私敏感数据、难以访问或缺乏足够的恶意活动来支持工具开发。本研究提出的框架利用生成式人工智能模型，生成高保真的合成网络安全数据集，这些数据集能够复制真实的设备行为、网络交互和网络攻击场景。合成数据集通过协议标准符合性、与原始数据集的统计相似性以及在常见安全工具中的实用性进行评估。该框架和评估指标预计将推动智慧城市网络安全研究，使研究人员能够更有效地建模威胁，更全面地评估防御技术，从而更好地保护关键智慧城市基础设施。

items.title: From Parameters to Feature Space: Task Arithmetic for Backdoor Mitigation in Model Merging
items.summary: Model merging (MM) has gained significant attention as a cost-effective approach to integrate multiple task-specific models into a unified model. However, recent work reveals that MM is highly susceptible to backdoor attacks. Existing defenses based on task arithmetic often fail to eliminate backdoors without substantially degrading clean-task performance, owing to their reliance on direct parameter-space editing. To address this gap, we propose Linear Feature Path Minimization (LFPM), a backdoor mitigation framework for model merging, which introduces an anti-backdoor task vector into the backdoored merged model. Unlike prior approaches, LFPM formulates the backdoor robustness of the merged model from a unified feature-space perspective under the Cross-Task Linearity (CTL) framework, which leverages the approximate linearity of features across tasks. This perspective guides the optimization of the anti-backdoor task to suppress backdoors while preserving clean-task performance. Furthermore, we introduce an effective optimization mechanism based on gradient accumulation and loss path-integral, ensuring robust backdoor suppression along the interpolation path. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LFPM consistently exhibits strong robustness against backdoor attacks in both full fine-tuning and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) settings.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 模型合并（Model Merging）是一种低成本整合多个任务特定模型的方法，但近期研究表明它对后门攻击高度敏感。现有的基于任务算术的防御方法由于直接编辑参数空间，往往在消除后门的同时严重损害干净任务性能。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了一种名为线性特征路径最小化（LFPM）的后门缓解框架，该框架在后门合并模型中引入一个反后门任务向量。与先前方法不同，LFPM从跨任务线性（CTL）框架下的统一特征空间视角形式化合并模型的后门鲁棒性，利用跨任务特征的近似线性特性。这一视角指导反后门任务的优化，以抑制后门同时保持干净任务性能。此外，作者提出了一种基于梯度累积和损失路径积分的有效优化机制，确保沿插值路径的鲁棒后门抑制。大量实验表明，LFPM在全微调和参数高效微调（PEFT）设置下均对后门攻击表现出强鲁棒性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 模型合并是AI安全领域的前沿方向，该研究揭示了其易受后门攻击的弱点，并提出了首个基于特征空间的防御方法，对保护多任务模型的完整性具有直接意义。

items.title: Categorical Robustness Assessment for Machine Learning based Network Intrusion Detection Systems
items.summary: Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS) heavily utlize Machine Learning (ML) but ML models can be manipulated via adversarial attacks. These attacks add carefully crafted perturbations to network traffic data that leads to misclassifications. While prior work has demonstrated adversarial vulnerabilities in isolated settings, systematic cross-architecture as well as class and category of attack based comparisons under controlled attack conditions remain limited, leaving practitioners without clear guidance on which models to deploy in adversarial environments. This paper asks a simple question: what type of classifier architectures actually hold up when attackers try to manipulate the systems? We put three popular architectures through their paces: a 1D Convolutional Neural Network, a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network, and a Random Forest (RF) ensemble. Using the ACI-IoT-2023 dataset (over 1.2 million samples spanning 12 attack types), we subject each model with FGSM and PGD adversarial attacks, which apply gradient-based perturbations in normalized feature space consistent with established adversarial ML evaluation protocols, at perturbation budgets ranging from $ε=0.01$ to $ε=0.1$. Surprisingly, Random Forest achieved near-perfect baseline accuracy (99.98\%), yet collapsed catastrophically under attack, dropping 73 percentage points at the smallest perturbation we tested. CNN, on the other hand, retained 95.5\% accuracy at $ε=0.01$ and degraded gracefully as perturbations increased. LSTM fell somewhere in between. These findings flip the conventional wisdom where high baseline accuracy means nothing if a model shatters at the first sign of adversarial pressure. For practitioners deploying intrusion detection in adversarial environments, we recommend CNN-based architectures and provide scenario-specific deployment guidance.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对基于机器学习的网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性进行系统性评估。尽管已有研究指出ML模型易受对抗性样本影响，但缺乏在控制条件下跨架构、跨攻击类别的公平比较，导致安全从业者难以选择可靠模型。本文采用ACI-IoT-2023数据集（包含超过120万样本，覆盖12种攻击类型），对三种主流分类器——一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）、长短期记忆网络（LSTM）和随机森林（RF）——进行对抗鲁棒性测试。攻击方法采用快速梯度符号法（FGSM）和投影梯度下降（PGD），在归一化特征空间施加梯度扰动，扰动预算从ε=0.01到0.1。实验结果表明：RF在无攻击时达到接近完美的基线准确率（99.98%），但遭受最小扰动（ε=0.01）后准确率骤降73个百分点；CNN在ε=0.01时仍保持95.5%准确率，且随扰动增大性能下降平缓；LSTM表现居中。该发现颠覆了“高基线准确率即高鲁棒性”的传统认知，为在对抗环境下部署NIDS提供了明确指引：推荐采用CNN架构，并给出了具体场景下的部署建议。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示主流ML-NIDS模型在对抗攻击下的真实鲁棒性差异，颠覆了高基线准确率等于高安全性的误区，为安全团队选择入侵检测架构提供实证依据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响NIDS模型选型决策，可推广至其他基于ML的网络安全检测系统（如恶意软件检测、异常检测）的对抗鲁棒性评估。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：建议安全工程师参考该对比方法论，对自身NIDS模型进行类似鲁棒性评估，并优先考虑CNN架构。

items.title: Undefined Behavior in C and C++: An Experiment With Desktop Use Cases
items.summary: Undefined behavior is idiomatic to C and C++ programming; such behavior is a use of an erroneous program construct for which the languages impose no requirements, such as integer overflows. The paper presents an empirical experiment seeking to probe the extent of undefined behavior executing underneath typical desktop use of a Linux distribution. The analysis is based on an undefined behavior sanitizer implemented in a compiler. According to the results, undefined behavior is common. By completing 59 simple experimental tasks, nearly 11 thousand unique undefined behavior warnings were generated by 32 unique programs and libraries written in C or C++. Of these warnings, most were associated with the Mesa graphics library and generated by interacting with graphical user interfaces. Merely logging into the GNOME desktop environment generated over 500 unique warnings. Of all warnings, the clear majority was about virtual table pointers. The associated stack traces were also lengthy in general. With these and other results, the paper contributes to the empirical literature on C and C++.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文通过实证实验探究了C和C++语言中未定义行为（undefined behavior）在典型桌面使用环境下的普遍性。未定义行为是使用错误程序构造时语言不施加任何要求的行为，例如整数溢出。研究使用Linux发行版（Fedora）中的未定义行为消毒器（undefined behavior sanitizer）进行检测，设计了59个简单的桌面交互任务，包括登录、打开文件、浏览网页等。结果发现，在32个用C或C++编写的程序和库中，生成了近11,000条独特的未定义行为警告。其中，绝大多数警告与Mesa图形库相关，通过图形用户界面交互触发。仅登录GNOME桌面环境就产生了超过500条警告。在所有警告中，绝大多数是关于虚表指针（virtual table pointers）的未定义行为，且相关的堆栈跟踪通常较长。研究还分析了未定义行为与程序特定行为之间的相关性。论文的主要贡献在于：提供了C/C++未定义行为在实际桌面使用中的大规模实证数据，揭示了其普遍性和潜在影响，并强调了现有编译器消毒器在检测此类行为方面的能力与局限。该研究适合编译器开发者、系统软件工程师以及关注C/C++安全性的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 未定义行为是C/C++安全漏洞的主要根源之一，该研究证实其在日常桌面环境中频繁发生，警示安全从业者必须重视底层软件中的未定义行为问题。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用C/C++编写的桌面应用、图形库（如Mesa）、桌面环境（如GNOME）及相关系统软件，未定义行为可能导致内存破坏、信息泄露等安全风险。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: InjectV: Modeling Fault Injection Attacks in RISC-V Simulation Environment
items.summary: Fault Injection Attacks (FIAs) are a significant threat to hardware security, capable of compromising systems by inducing malicious faults in computation or storage. Evaluating resilience against such attacks is challenging due to the high cost, complexity, and limited availability of physical fault experiments, particularly during pre-silicon development. Architectural-level simulation offers a developer-oriented, white-box perspective for systematic vulnerability assessment. This paper introduces InjectV, a fault injection attack framework for RISC-V platforms built on the gem5 simulator. InjectV enables precise, guided fault injection at security-critical execution points, such as control-flow decisions, counters, and comparisons, allowing systematic exploration of attack vectors. It currently supports transient fault attacks in registers and memory, broadening its ability to simulate diverse attack scenarios. Experimental results on security benchmarks from the FISSC suite, including hardened variants of the VerifyPIN application, demonstrate InjectV's ability to effectively identify fault-injection points, achieving a 95.8% time-saving advantage over traditional fault injection approaches.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 InjectV，一个针对 RISC-V 平台的故障注入攻击建模框架，基于 gem5 模拟器实现。该框架旨在解决硬件安全评估中物理故障注入实验成本高、复杂度大、可用性有限等问题，特别是在硅前开发阶段。InjectV 提供了开发者导向的白盒视角，支持在安全关键执行点（如控制流决策、计数器、比较操作）进行精准引导的故障注入，允许系统性地探索攻击向量。目前支持寄存器和内存中的瞬态故障攻击，能够模拟多种攻击场景。实验使用 FISSC 基准测试套件中的安全应用（包括 VerifyPIN 的硬化变体）进行验证，结果表明 InjectV 能有效识别故障注入点，相比传统故障注入方法节省 95.8% 的时间。该框架为 RISC-V 硬件安全设计提供了一种高效、可扩展的预硅评估工具。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 硬件安全是系统安全的基石，故障注入攻击威胁严重。InjectV 为硅前阶段 RISC-V 设计提供了低成本、自动化的故障注入评估能力，有助于在早期发现硬件安全漏洞。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响 RISC-V 处理器设计的安全验证流程，可迁移至其他基于 gem5 的体系结构安全评估中。

items.title: Online Shift Detection and Conformal Adaptation for Deployed Safety Classifiers
items.summary: We present an online monitoring system for distributional shift in deployed safety classifiers, using calibrated sequential statistics to detect when a classifier has moved out of distribution. Upon detection, a conformal abstention layer adapts decision thresholds to recover a target error rate epsilon=0.1. In a pre-registered factorial evaluation (4 classifiers x 5 shift conditions x 20 seeds x 2 window sizes, 800 cells), the system achieves 86.6% valid detection (693/800, 95% CI [84.1%, 88.8%]) with mean latency of 39.5 steps. Detection holds across three ground-truth regimes: synthetic onset (86.6%), real temporal jailbreaks (85%, 17/20), and GCG adversarial attacks. Weighted conformal prediction recovers up to 39 pp of lost coverage for DeBERTa (ESS=46/300) but collapses for all other classifiers (ESS~300): logistic density ratio estimation achieves perfect source/target separability in high-dimensional embedding spaces, clipping all importance weights to the floor. DeBERTa shows a gradient from effective correction (paraphrase, ESS=46) to near-total collapse (adversarial suffix, ESS=206). PCA to 32 dimensions breaks the collapse, recovering 33 pp for Llama Guard and 21 pp for ShieldGemma. Variance decomposition reveals classifier (eta^2=0.243), shift type (eta^2=0.237), and their interaction (eta^2=0.185) all contribute substantially to detection latency variance (all p<0.001), indicating per-classifier monitoring profiles are necessary.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种针对部署中安全分类器的在线分布漂移监测系统。该系统利用校准的顺序统计量来检测分类器是否已移出分布范围。一旦检测到漂移，系统会通过一个共形拒绝层调整决策阈值，以恢复目标错误率 epsilon=0.1。在预注册的析因评估中（4个分类器 × 5种漂移条件 × 20个种子 × 2个窗口大小，共800个单元），系统实现了86.6%的有效检测率（693/800，95%置信区间[84.1%, 88.8%]），平均延迟为39.5步。检测效果在三种真实标签机制下保持一致：合成起始（86.6%）、真实时间越狱（85%，17/20）和GCG对抗攻击。加权共形预测能够为DeBERTa恢复高达39个百分点的覆盖率损失（ESS=46/300），但其他所有分类器均失效（ESS≈300）：逻辑密度比估计在高维嵌入空间中实现了完美的源/目标分离，将所有重要性权重裁剪到最低值。DeBERTa表现出从有效校正（paraphrase，ESS=46）到几乎完全失效（对抗后缀，ESS=206）的梯度。将维度降至32的PCA打破了这种失效，为Llama Guard恢复33个百分点，为ShieldGemma恢复21个百分点。方差分解表明，分类器（eta^2=0.243）、漂移类型（eta^2=0.237）及其交互作用（eta^2=0.185）均对检测延迟方差有显著贡献（所有p<0.001），说明需要针对每个分类器进行监控配置。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为部署安全分类器时应对分布漂移提供了实用的在线监测和自适应方法，有助于提升LLM安全护栏的鲁棒性，值得安全工程师关注。

items.title: Image Quality Assessment of Identity Cards Using Measures from Open Face Image Quality
items.summary: This paper addresses the challenge of assessing image quality in ID cards in remote verification systems by applying capture-related quality measures from the Open Face Image Quality (OFIQ) standard to ID card images. Our preprocessing pipeline includes corner detection, perspective normalization, and comprehensive foreground masking to ensure accurate and unbiased quality measure computation. We evaluate the effectiveness of these measures by analyzing their correlation with the performance of three presentation attack detection (PAD) algorithms across four diverse ID card datasets, where two datasets contain bona fide, i.e. pristine, images and two contain printed mock ID cards. Our results suggest that quality assessment based on some OFIQ measures can significantly improve PAD performance.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对远程身份验证系统中身份证图像质量评估的挑战，提出应用来自开放人脸图像质量（OFIQ）标准的采集相关质量度量到身份证图像上。预处理流程包括角点检测、透视归一化和全面的前景掩膜，以确保质量度量的准确和无偏计算。作者通过分析这些度量与三种呈现攻击检测（PAD）算法性能的相关性，在四个不同的身份证数据集上评估其有效性，其中两个数据集包含真实（即原始）图像，两个包含打印的模拟身份证。结果表明，基于某些OFIQ度量的质量评估可以显著提升PAD性能。该研究为身份证图像质量评估提供了新的视角，并证明了标准化质量度量在增强远程验证系统安全性方面的潜力。适合计算机视觉、生物特征识别和安全领域的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究通过将标准化的图像质量度量应用于身份证验证，展示了提升呈现攻击检测性能的可行性，对于增强远程身份验证系统的安全性具有实际意义。

items.title: Feature-Aligned Speech Watermarking for Robustness to Reconstruction Distortions
items.summary: Audio watermarking aims to embed identifiable information into audio while remaining imperceptible. Existing methods adopt high-fidelity, low-energy designs to preserve perceptual quality, but the resulting watermarks lack robustness under suppression by speech reconstruction models. Improving robustness is challenging due to the inherent robustness-fidelity trade-off in existing designs, where increasing watermark energy improves robustness but reduces fidelity. To address this problem, we propose a feature-aligned watermarking method that aligns the watermark with the original speech feature distribution, allowing higher watermark energy to improve robustness while preserving imperceptibility. We use a pretrained speech codec to generate a pseudo-speech watermark and fuse it into the spectrogram of the input audio, with VAD loss and perceptual losses guiding embedding within voiced regions. Experiments show that our method maintains imperceptibility comparable to existing approaches while substantially improving robustness under both seen and unseen speech reconstruction models.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对音频水印技术在面对语音重建模型（如基于神经网络的编解码器）时的鲁棒性问题展开研究。现有方法通常采用高保真、低能量的设计来保持感知质量，但这类水印在语音重建模型的抑制下容易失效。提高水印能量虽能增强鲁棒性，却会降低不可感知性，形成鲁棒性与保真度之间的固有矛盾。为解决该问题，作者提出一种特征对齐的水印方法，核心思想是将水印与原始语音的特征分布对齐，从而允许嵌入更高能量的水印以提升鲁棒性，同时不牺牲不可感知性。具体地，方法利用预训练语音编解码器生成伪语音水印，并将其融合到输入音频的梅尔频谱图中，通过语音活动检测（VAD）损失和感知损失指导水印仅在语音活跃区域嵌入，避免在静音段引入噪声。实验在多个语音重建模型（包括已见和未见模型）上进行评估，结果表明该方法在保持与现有方法相当的不可感知性的前提下，显著提升了水印对重建失真的鲁棒性。本文主要贡献在于揭示了鲁棒性与保真度的权衡并提出特征对齐策略，为音频水印的实用化提供了新思路。适合对音频安全、数字水印、生成模型防御感兴趣的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 音频水印是数字版权保护和内容认证的重要技术，但现有方法难以抵抗语音重建模型的攻击。本文提出的特征对齐方案在不牺牲听感质量的前提下大幅提升鲁棒性，对保障AI生成内容的安全溯源有直接价值。

items.title: Jaguar: Fast Private CNN Inference with Power-of-Two Homomorphic Arithmetic
items.summary: Hybrid HE/2PC private CNN inference remains bottlenecked by prime-modulus homomorphic arithmetic in convolution and by a precision flow that runs ReLU at doubled bitwidth before invoking a separate truncation protocol. We present Jaguar, a system built on a single design choice--a power-of-two ciphertext ring--that addresses both. The choice enables SPA-Conv, a coefficient-domain convolution kernel that replaces NTT-centric polynomial multiplication with scalar-polynomial accumulation, and an exact ciphertext-side truncation by local right shifts that lets ReLU run directly at the target fixed-point precision and eliminates the post-ReLU truncation protocol. Where NTT remains genuinely useful--at the client, for the single polynomial multiplication during decryption--we recover it through an auxiliary NTT prime, preserving the power-of-two protocol substrate while keeping decryption O(N log N). On ImageNet-scale ResNet-18, ResNet-50, and MobileNetV2 with AVX disabled, Jaguar achieves 2.07-3.72x lower end-to-end latency than Cheetah and 2.16-3.36x lower than Rhombus, with 1.16-1.76x lower communication than Cheetah.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出Jaguar系统，旨在加速基于混合同态加密（HE）与两方安全计算（2PC）的私有卷积神经网络推理。现有混合方案的主要瓶颈来自两点：一是卷积层中基于素数模数的同态算术，二是精度流中需要在双倍位宽下执行ReLU后再调用单独的截断协议。Jaguar的核心设计选择是采用2的幂次方密文环，从而同时解决这两个问题。在该设计下，作者提出了SPA-Conv，一种系数域卷积核，它以标量-多项式累加替代了以NTT为中心的多项式乘法，从而减少了计算开销。同时，由于2的幂次方环支持通过本地右移实现精确的密文侧截断，ReLU可以直接在目标定点精度上运行，省去了ReLU后的截断协议。对于在解密过程中真正需要NTT的场景——即客户端仅有的多项式乘法，作者通过引入辅助NTT素数来恢复NTT的高效性，使得解密复杂度维持为O(N log N)，同时保留了2的幂次方协议底层。实验在ImageNet规模的ResNet-18、ResNet-50和MobileNetV2上进行，且关闭了AVX指令集。结果显示，与Cheetah相比，Jaguar的端到端延迟降低了2.07-3.72倍，与Rhombus相比降低了2.16-3.36倍，通信量比Cheetah降低了1.16-1.76倍。本文的方法适用于需要高性能私有推理的云服务或边缘场景，适合从事安全机器学习、密码学及系统优化的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 私有CNN推理是安全机器学习的关键应用，现有方案性能瓶颈明显。Jaguar通过简洁的2的幂次方环设计，在保持安全性的同时大幅提升速度和降低通信，为实际部署私有推理提供了更可行的方案。

items.title: Toward Trustworthy AI: Multi-Target Adversarial Attacks and Robust Defenses for Continuous Data Summarization
items.summary: Trustworthy AI requires reliable data-processing pipelines, not only robust downstream predictive models. As an upstream component, data summarization determines which information is retained and passed to subsequent learning or decision modules. Therefore, adversarial perturbations to the summarization process can compromise trustworthy AI in an upstream manner: they may alter the selected summary, reduce its representativeness, and further degrade the utility of subsequent learning tasks. In this paper, we study adversarial attacks on continuous data summarization under similarity-level perturbations through DR-submodular optimization. We show that a class of multi-resolution image summarization objectives can be formulated as multilinear extensions of non-negative submodular set functions and satisfy DR-submodularity with $m$-weak monotonicity. We then formulate multi-target attack generation as a min-max problem, where one admissible perturbation of the similarity structure is optimized to degrade multiple target summarization models. To mitigate such perturbations, we formulate robust defense against mixed attack types as a regularized max-min problem. For both problems, we develop approximation algorithms with theoretical guarantees. Experiments on real-data and controlled clustered benchmarks show that the proposed attack is effective in representative low-to-moderate budget regimes and can induce downstream task-performance loss. The proposed defense improves the robustness--mitigation trade-off in structured settings, while also revealing the parameter sensitivity of robust protection on real data.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对可信人工智能中的数据汇总环节提出了一种对抗性攻击与防御方法。数据汇总作为上游组件，负责决定哪些信息被保留并传递给后续的学习或决策模块。攻击者可以通过相似性级别的扰动来破坏汇总过程，从而改变所选摘要、降低代表性，并进一步损害下游任务的效用。论文首先证明了一类多分辨率图像汇总目标可以表示为非负子模集函数的多线性扩展，并满足带m-弱单调性的DR-子模性质。然后，将多目标攻击生成形式化为一个最小-最大问题，优化一个允许的相似性结构扰动以同时破坏多个目标汇总模型。为缓解此类扰动，又将针对混合攻击类型的鲁棒防御形式化为一个正则化的最大-最小问题。对于两个问题，论文都开发了具有理论保证的近似算法。在真实数据和受控聚类基准上的实验表明，所提出的攻击在低到中等预算范围内有效，并能导致下游任务性能损失；所提出的防御在结构化设置中改善了鲁棒性-缓解权衡，同时也揭示了真实数据上鲁棒保护的参数敏感性。该研究适合安全研究员、AI系统开发者及关注AI可信度的从业者阅读。

items.title: SwarmSense-DNN: A Trustworthy and Decentralized Neural Framework for Proactive Anomaly Defense in Consumer IoT
items.summary: The rapid growth of consumer IoT devices has introduced unprecedented challenges in trustworthy anomaly detection against AI-enabled cyber threats, requiring real-time, privacy-preserving, and scalable defense mechanisms. Traditional centralized strategies face critical limitations, including communication bottlenecks, single points of failure, and privacy vulnerabilities when processing distributed consumer data. We propose SwarmSense-DNN, a novel decentralized neural framework employing swarm intelligence for secure, cooperative anomaly detection across distributed IoT environments. The framework integrates autonomous agents with deep neural networks to form a self-organizing defense system that detects evolving anomalies without centralized coordination. It utilizes hierarchical federated learning with graph neural networks and attention mechanisms to capture local and global anomaly behaviors while ensuring data privacy. Extensive experiments demonstrate SwarmSense-DNN's superior performance: it achieves 95.44% average detection accuracy across five benchmark datasets while reducing communication overhead by 67%. The framework maintains robust resilience against adversarial threats through differential privacy safeguards and demonstrates strong fault tolerance under node failures and AI-enabled attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着消费物联网设备的快速增长，针对AI赋能的网络威胁的可靠异常检测面临着实时性、隐私保护和可扩展性的挑战。传统的集中式策略在分布式消费数据处理中存在通信瓶颈、单点故障和隐私漏洞。本文提出SwarmSense-DNN，一种新颖的去中心化神经网络框架，采用群体智能在分布式物联网环境中实现安全、协作的异常检测。该框架将自主智能体与深度神经网络相结合，形成无需集中协调即可检测演化异常的自组织防御系统。它利用分层联邦学习、图神经网络和注意力机制捕捉局部和全局异常行为，同时确保数据隐私。大量实验表明，SwarmSense-DNN在五个基准数据集上平均检测准确率达到95.44%，通信开销降低67%。该框架通过差分隐私保护机制保持对对抗威胁的鲁棒性，并在节点故障和AI攻击下表现出强大的容错能力。

items.title: MHOT: Height-Optimized Authenticated Data Structure for Blockchain State Commitment
items.summary: State root computation dominates (78%) blockchain block processing time. Ethereum's canonical authenticated data structure, i.e., Merkle Patricia Trie (MPT), suffers from severe tree-height growth and is vulnerable to \textit{Nurgle attacks} (SP'24), where adversaries inflate path depth via hash collisions and degrade system performance at negligible cost. Existing defenses increase node fanout (span) to bound tree height, but higher span inflates proof size exponentially. Prior work mitigates this trade-off using vector commitments, at the cost of trusted setup or expensive verification. We present \textsc{Mhot}, a height-optimal authenticated data structure for blockchain state commitment that preserves standard hash-based verification without trusted setup. Unlike MPT's fixed-prefix indexing, which couples span and fanout exponentially, \textsc{Mhot} indexes by discriminative bits that actually distinguish keys, achieving adaptive span with linear fanout coupling and provably minimal height. To prevent high fanout from inflating proofs, we introduce hierarchical proofs, a two-layer Merkle construction that reduces per-node proof overhead from O(k) to O(log k). On Ethereum mainnet workloads, \textsc{Mhot} achieves up to 9X higher write throughput, 4X lower write amplification, and 2X smaller proofs than MPT. Under Nurgle attacks, even when the adversary consumes an entire block's gas budget, \textsc{Mhot} maintains a 0% attack success rate (v.s., 99.97% for MPT). Our results, somewhat surprisingly, show that height optimality (not new crypto primitives!) is the key abstraction for scalable and attack-resilient blockchain state commitment.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对区块链状态承诺中认证数据结构的性能与安全性问题展开研究。当前以太坊采用的标准数据结构 Merkle Patricia Trie (MPT) 存在两大缺陷：一是树高度随数据量增长而急剧增加，导致状态根计算耗时占区块处理时间的78%；二是容易受到 Nurgle 攻击（SP'24），攻击者通过哈希碰撞人为扩充路径深度，以极低成本显著降低系统性能。已有防御方案通过增加节点扇出（span）来限制树高，但会指数级增大证明大小；而使用向量承诺虽可缓解该权衡，却引入了可信设置或高验证开销。论文提出 MHOT（高度最优的认证数据结构），核心创新包括：1）采用判别位索引代替 MPT 的固定前缀索引，仅针对实际区分键的比特位进行索引，实现自适应跨度且扇出与键数线性相关，证明在理论上达到最小高度；2）提出分层证明（hierarchical proofs）—— 一种双层 Merkle 结构，将每节点证明开销从 O(k) 降至 O(log k)，避免高扇出导致证明膨胀。在以太坊主网负载下的实验表明：MHOT 相比 MPT 实现高达9倍的写吞吐量提升、4倍的写放大降低、2倍更小的证明大小。面对 Nurgle 攻击，即使攻击者消耗整个区块的 Gas 预算，MHOT 仍保持0%的攻击成功率（MPT 则为99.97%）。论文结论指出，高度最优性（而非新型密码原语）是实现可扩展且抗攻击的区块链状态承诺的关键抽象。

llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至任何基于 Merkle 树的分布式账本或存储系统，优化认证数据结构的设计范式。

items.title: Sovereign Assurance Boundary: Certificate-Bound Admission for Agentic Infrastructure
items.summary: Agentic infrastructure introduces a critical control-plane authorization problem: non-deterministic reasoning systems can propose high-stakes mutations to production resources, yet existing security mechanisms -- such as identity and access management (IAM), policy engines, consensus protocols, and audit logs -- either enforce static, context-unaware permissions or merely record actions post-execution. This paper introduces the Sovereign Assurance Boundary (SAB), a certificate-bound runtime admission layer for autonomous execution authority. SAB intercepts agent proposals at an assurance airlock, compiles them into typed execution contracts $C$, and binds these contracts to cryptographic evidence digests $H(E)$ and policy versions. The contracts are then routed through consequence-aware certification paths. Upon successful admission, the system emits a signed Sovereign Assurance Certificate ($Ω$) that is strictly scoped to a specific execution identity, revocation epoch, and validity window. Finally, a sovereign execution broker verifies $Ω$ and performs fresh pre-execution revocation and drift checks before invoking infrastructure APIs. We detail the airlock-broker architecture, formalize its admission and revocation invariants, and report preliminary feasibility measurements from a Go prototype evaluated over 2,500 admission attempts. Ultimately, this broker-enforced model prevents autonomous reasoning from directly mutating state, transforming delegated execution authority into a cryptographically verifiable, evidence-bound, revocable, and replayable runtime artifact.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对智能体基础设施中出现的控制平面授权问题，提出了一种名为“主权保证边界”（Sovereign Assurance Boundary, SAB）的架构。在传统身份与访问管理（IAM）、策略引擎、共识协议和审计日志等机制无法有效应对非确定性推理系统可能对生产资源发起高风险变更的背景下，SAB 设计了一个证书绑定的运行时准入层。其核心工作流程是：首先通过“保证气闸”拦截智能体提出的操作建议，将其编译为带类型的执行合约 C，并将合约绑定到密码学证据摘要 H(E) 和策略版本上；然后通过“后果感知认证路径”路由这些合约；准入成功后，系统签发一个严格限定于特定执行身份、撤销纪元、有效窗口的签名主权保证证书 Ω；最后，一个“主权执行代理”在调用基础设施 API 前验证 Ω 并执行实时的预先撤销和漂移检查。本文详细阐述了气闸-代理架构，形式化定义了准入和撤销不变量，并基于 Go 原型在 2500 次准入尝试上报告了初步可行性测量结果。该模型将自主推理与直接状态变更隔离，将委托的执行权限转化为密码学上可验证、证据绑定、可撤销且可重放的运行时工件。

items.title: Adv-TGD: Adversarial Text-Guided Diffusion for Face Recognition Impersonation Attacks
items.summary: The widespread adoption of face recognition (FR) technologies raises serious privacy concerns, as facial data can be exploited without consent. To address this challenge, we propose Adv-TGD, a generative adversarial attack framework that synthesizes photorealistic faces capable of impersonating target identities and deceiving face recognition systems. Built upon Stable Diffusion, Adv-TGD performs per-sample LoRA fine-tuning conditioned on concise textual prompts to generate natural yet adversarially manipulated identities. Unlike conventional identity-attack approaches, our method optimizes lightweight cross-attention adapters for each source-target pair within a single-step denoising process. Latent blending is constrained by a face-local heatmap mask to ensure spatially precise identity manipulation while preserving non-sensitive regions. We introduce a composite objective that integrates masked epsilon-MSE reconstruction, thresholded identity divergence in FR embedding space, directional feature alignment, and source-similarity suppression to balance adversarial attack and visual realism. Optionally, LLaVA-generated attribute prompts enhance fine-grained semantic details without reintroducing identity cues. Under the black-box evaluation protocol, Adv-TGD attains an average attack success rate (ASR) of 85.90% across IR152, IRSE50, MobileFace, and FaceNet, surpassing the semantic SOTA baseline Adv-CPG by +6.25 points, diffusion-based makeup method DiffAIM by +3 points, and noise-based P3-Mask by +16 points. Despite its strong attack efficacy, Adv-TGD preserves high visual fidelity (PSNR = 27.15 dB, SSIM = 0.981). Furthermore, we demonstrate the flexibility of our framework by successfully extending it to in-the-wild datasets (LADN), general object classification (ImageNet), and transformer-based diffusion models (FLUX.1).

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一种名为 Adv-TGD 的生成式对抗攻击框架，旨在通过文本引导的扩散模型合成能够冒充目标身份的照片级人脸图像，从而欺骗人脸识别系统。该框架基于 Stable Diffusion，对每个源-目标身份对执行单样本 LoRA 微调，利用简洁的文本提示生成自然但具有对抗性的人脸。与传统身份攻击方法不同，Adv-TGD 在单步去噪过程中优化轻量级交叉注意力适配器。通过人脸局部热力图掩码约束潜在空间混合，确保空间精确的身份操控同时保留非敏感区域。方法引入复合目标函数，结合掩码 epsilon-MSE 重建损失、人脸识别嵌入空间中的阈值化身份差异损失、方向特征对齐损失及源相似性抑制损失，以平衡攻击效果与视觉真实性。可选地，由 LLaVA 生成的属性提示可增强细粒度语义细节而不引入身份线索。在黑盒评估协议下，Adv-TGD 在 IR152、IRSE50、MobileFace 和 FaceNet 四个模型上平均攻击成功率达到 85.90%，超过语义 SOTA 基线 Adv-CPG（+6.25 点）、扩散基化妆方法 DiffAIM（+3 点）及噪声基 P3-Mask（+16 点）。同时保持高视觉保真度（PSNR=27.15 dB，SSIM=0.981）。此外，该框架成功扩展到野外数据集（LADN）、通用对象分类（ImageNet）及基于 Transformer 的扩散模型（FLUX.1），展示了灵活性。

items.title: Superspace Concentration and Adversarial Robustness in Quantum Algorithms
items.summary: We study superspace concentration as a quantum resource, formalized through the focus measure F(\r{ho}) = λ_max(\r{ho}_super) - the largest eigenvalue of the reduced superspace state - which quantifies the capacity of a quantum system to concentrate informational weight into a preferred subspace of an extended degree-of-freedom space. We develop a complete resource-theoretic framework around this measure and validate its properties through GPU-accelerated numerical simulation. Analytic decoherence predictions are confirmed to machine precision (1.11 x 10^{-16}) for superspace dimensions dS in {2,4,8,16,32}. Focus monotonicity holds across 10,000 random states with zero violations under four focus-non-generating channels across six system configurations. Focused quantum states resist coherent unitary attacks with significantly greater resilience than standard fidelity predicts, with focus remaining above 0.9 at attack strength ε = 0.302 versus ε = 0.174 for fidelity. We further demonstrate that the focus measure and the U(dS)-asymmetry measure are operationally distinct: asymmetry remains near zero and provides no robustness signal under coherent and targeted attacks while focus tracks spectral concentration and remains robust until ε > 0.3. The connection between Grover's algorithm and superspace concentration is made explicit via the identity F(|ψ_k><ψ_k|) = P(marked), providing a resource-theoretic interpretation of oracle query complexity. Finally, we provide the first numerical characterization of the focus capacity gap ΔF, identifying a log_2(dS) scaling law confirmed for both product and correlated noise channels.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出并形式化了量子算法中的“超空间集中度”（superspace concentration）这一量子资源概念，通过焦点度量 F(ρ) = λ_max(ρ_super)（约化超空间状态的最大本征值）量化量子系统将信息权重集中到扩展自由度空间中的优先子空间的能力。作者围绕该度量建立了完整的资源理论框架，并通过 GPU 加速数值模拟验证了其性质：解析退相干预测在超空间维度 dS ∈ {2,4,8,16,32} 上达到机器精度（1.11×10^{-16}）；在六种系统配置下的四种非焦点生成通道上，对 10,000 个随机状态验证了焦点单调性，零违规。实验表明，集中量子态抵抗相干酉攻击的韧性显著优于标准保真度预测：在攻击强度 ε = 0.302 时焦点仍高于 0.9，而保真度在 ε = 0.174 时已下降。进一步证明焦点度量与 U(dS)-非对称性度量在操作上不同：非对称性在相干和非相干目标攻击下保持近零且无鲁棒性信号，而焦点能跟踪谱集中度并在 ε > 0.3 前保持鲁棒。通过恒等式 F(|ψ_k⟩⟨ψ_k|) = P(marked) 明确 Grover 算法与超空间集中度的联系，为预言机查询复杂度提供了资源理论解释。最后，首次数值表征了焦点容量间隙 ΔF，识别出 log2(dS) 标度律，并在乘积噪声和关联噪声通道上得到验证。该工作为量子算法的鲁棒性分析提供了新视角，适合量子计算、量子纠错和安全领域的研究者阅读。

items.title: A Deterministic Forensic Preprocessing Framework for Heterogeneous Network Datasets: Formal Foundations, Implementation, and Empirical Validation
items.summary: Digital forensic investigations increasingly depend on preprocessing heterogeneous network evidence from intrusion detection systems, IoT devices, and enterprise traffic logs. Incompatible schemas and timestamp formats hinder evidence correlation and timeline reconstruction, while current ad hoc approaches offer no mechanism to verify consistency across runs or analysis, creating reproducibility gaps that challenge evidence admissibility. This paper introduces a deterministic forensic preprocessing framework that converts heterogeneous network datasets into a reproducible canonical form. The framework formalises three preprocessing transformations: schema normalisation, temporal normalisation, and provenance tracking. These transformations are specified using set-theoretic definitions and supported by four theorems establishing determinism, information preservation, and provenance completeness. A chunk-based architecture provides O(c) bounded memory. Empirical evaluation across UNSW-NB15, IoT-23, and TON_IoT demonstrates 100% output consistency across repeated runs, robust temporal normalisation completeness over heterogeneous timestamp formats, and scalable performance from millions to hundreds of millions of records.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对数字取证中异构网络数据集预处理的可重现性问题，提出了一种确定性预处理框架。当前取证实践中，入侵检测系统、物联网设备和企业流量日志等来源的数据格式不兼容，时间戳格式多样，导致证据关联和时间线重建困难。现有的临时方法无法保证跨运行结果的一致性，造成可重现性缺口，影响证据的法律可采性。论文形式化定义了三种预处理变换：模式规范化、时间规范化和来源追踪，使用集合论定义并辅以四个定理证明其确定性、信息保持性和来源完整性。框架采用基于块的架构，实现O(c)有界内存。在UNSW-NB15、IoT-23和TON_IoT数据集上的实验表明，重复运行输出100%一致，时间规范化覆盖所有异构时间戳格式，并可扩展到数亿条记录。该工作为数字取证提供了可验证、可复现的预处理基础，适合取证分析师、网络安全研究人员及法律证据评估者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架解决了数字取证中证据预处理不可重现的痛点，首次提供形式化保障，对提升电子证据的可采性和司法信任具有关键意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响数字取证流程的规范性和证据法律效力；可迁移至SOC日志分析、合规审计等需长期一致性场景。

items.title: WHET: Welding Homomorphic Encryption to Accelerator Architectures
items.summary: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) enables computations on encrypted data without decryption, offering strong data privacy at the expense of substantial computational and memory overheads. Prior efforts have steadily improved FHE performance through cryptographic and algorithmic enhancements or hardware acceleration, yet these two directions have progressed largely in isolation, hindering the full exploitation of available hardware capabilities. This work presents WHET, which introduces memory-centric, architecture-aware optimizations to better align cryptographic and algorithmic constructions with FHE accelerator architectures. We identify conventional FHE constructions as major sources of excessive working sets and heavy off-chip memory traffic. We propose accelerator-specific techniques, including fine-grained coefficient-to-slot transformation, plaintext compression, and intermediate modulus raising, to reduce the on-chip data footprint by minimizing temporary ciphertexts and plaintext loads. With these techniques applied, we observe additional opportunities to improve on-chip memory efficiency; hence, we introduce lightweight architectural refinements, including a special-purpose buffer and functional unit extensions. With these optimizations, WHET achieves 1.38-8.74$\times$ per-area performance improvements over state-of-the-art FHE accelerators and the first-ever sub-millisecond CKKS bootstrapping.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 全同态加密（FHE）允许在不解密的情况下对加密数据进行计算，为数据隐私提供强保护，但代价是巨大的计算和内存开销。以往的研究通过密码学/算法优化或硬件加速分别提升FHE性能，但两者往往孤立进行，未能充分利用硬件能力。本文提出WHET，一种以内存为中心、架构感知的优化框架，旨在将密码学与算法构造更好地适配到FHE加速器架构。作者识别出传统FHE构造是导致过大工作集和繁重片外内存流量的主要来源，并为此提出了加速器专用技术：细粒度系数到槽变换、明文压缩和中间模数提升，通过减少临时密文和明文加载来降低片上数据占用。在此基础上，进一步引入轻量级架构改进，包括专用缓冲区和功能单元扩展，以提升片上内存效率。实验表明，WHET在每面积性能上比最先进的FHE加速器提升1.38-8.74倍，并首次实现亚毫秒级的CKKS自举操作。该工作为FHE的实际部署提供了有效路径，适用于云计算、医疗数据隐私等对安全计算有高要求的场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 全同态加密是隐私计算的核心技术，但性能瓶颈严重阻碍了实际应用。WHET通过协同优化算法与硬件，显著提升了FHE加速器性能，为安全数据处理的实用化迈出重要一步，值得关注隐私计算的安全工程师追踪。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到云计算环境中的隐私保护机器学习、医疗数据联合分析等场景，为需要高强度数据隐私保护的应用提供高性能加密计算基础。

items.title: VIPIR: A Versatile GPU Framework for Integrating Private Information Retrieval Protocols
items.summary: While private information retrieval (PIR) enables private database services by fully concealing access patterns, it simultaneously requires high computational throughput, large memory capacity, and substantial memory bandwidth. We introduce VIPIR, a versatile GPU framework that co-designs PIR protocols with GPU acceleration. We develop a unified analytic model showing that state-of-the-art PIR protocols fall into two categories with complementary limitations, and propose two protocols that flexibly combine techniques across these categories, overcoming the limitations of both classes. These protocols incorporate a GPU-friendly data compression method called expansion-based ring packing (ExpPack), which offers a high degree of parallelism and minimal communication cost. VIPIR applies further optimizations to core operations, including number-theoretic transforms (NTTs) and various matrix-matrix multiplications (GEMMs). Notably, we develop a tensor-core-based execution method for database multiplication by interpreting it as a mixed-integer-type GEMM. We also design memory-efficient scheduling methods that minimize intermediate buffers and enable multi-GPU scaling under memory capacity constraints. Overall, VIPIR achieves orders-of-magnitude higher throughput than prior PIR systems while reducing communication and memory overheads, making large-scale PIR practical.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出VIPIR，一个面向GPU的通用框架，用于集成和加速私有信息检索（PIR）协议。PIR技术能够隐藏用户的数据库访问模式，从而保护查询隐私，但其计算开销、内存容量和带宽需求极高，限制了实际部署。VIPIR首先通过统一分析模型揭示现有PIR协议的两大类（基于同态加密和基于混淆电路）各有互补性局限，进而提出两种混合协议，灵活结合两类技术的优势，克服各自短板。这些协议采用一种名为ExpPack的GPU友好型数据压缩方法，该方法基于扩展环打包，具有高并行度和低通信开销。此外，VIPIR对核心操作进行深度优化，包括数论变换（NTT）和多种矩阵乘法（GEMM），特别是将数据库乘法解释为混合整数型GEMM并利用张量核心执行。框架还设计了内存高效的调度策略，最小化中间缓冲区，并支持在多GPU间扩展以突破内存容量瓶颈。实验表明，VIPIR相比此前PIR系统实现数量级吞吐量提升，同时降低通信和内存开销，使大规模PIR变得实用。本文适合对隐私保护数据库、GPU加速密码计算感兴趣的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: VIPIR显著降低PIR的实用门槛，使大规模隐私保护数据库查询成为可能，对安全基础设施的隐私增强有重要价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至任何需要隐藏访问模式的数据库服务场景，如医疗数据查询、金融情报检索等。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Hiding the Trees in the Forest: Building Network Covert Channels with Hash-Based Covert Carrier Filtering
items.summary: As an effective anti-censorship mechanism, network covert channels can provide data privacy protection and ensure communication security. However, the covertness of existing network covert channels primarily depends on the secrecy of their covert algorithms. With the increasing depth of research in this field, the difficulty of breaking such algorithms has gradually decreased. Once the algorithm is exposed, the network covert channel can be easily detected by adversaries. To address this issue, this paper proposes a covert carrier filtering strategy based on the hash. In this strategy, a key-dependent filtering rule is introduced during the construction of the network covert channel, enabling the communicating parties to randomly and dynamically filter a sparse subset from the carrier set as the covert carrier set. This strategy not only enhances the randomness of carrier selection but also tightly couples the covertness of the network covert channel with the security of the key. We employ machine learning-based traffic analysis methods to experimentally validate the strategy in two types of network covert channels: network storage and timing covert channels. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed strategy significantly improves the detection resistance of network covert channels. When the filter key size exceeds six bits, the impact on the detection effect of the classifier becomes quite significant. Furthermore, the processing delay for a single packet is less than 8 $μs$, indicating the feasibility of deploying the proposed strategy in high-speed network environments.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对现有网络隐蔽信道在算法暴露后容易被检测的问题，提出了一种基于哈希的隐蔽载体滤波策略。核心思想是在构建隐蔽信道时，引入密钥依赖的过滤规则，使通信双方能够从载体集合中随机动态地选取一个稀疏子集作为实际使用的隐蔽载体集。该策略增强了载体选取的随机性，并将隐蔽信道的隐蔽性与密钥安全性紧密耦合，即使算法公开，只要密钥未知，检测者仍难以识别信道。作者采用基于机器学习的流量分析方法，分别在网络存储型隐蔽信道和网络定时隐蔽信道两种典型场景下进行了实验验证。实验结果显示，所提策略显著提高了网络隐蔽信道的抗检测能力：当过滤密钥大小超过6位时，对分类器检测效果的影响变得非常显著；同时，单个数据包的处理延迟小于8微秒，表明该策略能够应用于高速网络环境。研究贡献在于提供了一种将隐蔽性从算法保密转向密钥依赖的新思路，增强了隐蔽信道在现实中的实用性和抗分析能力。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了隐蔽信道的一种新型增强技术，可能被攻击者用于绕过网络监控，对网络安全防御和反审查技术开发具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 虽然该策略由研究者提出，但类似思想可能被恶意软件或审查回避工具采用，提升其通信隐蔽性，对网络检测系统构成挑战。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: What Do Deepfake Speech Detectors Actually Hear?
items.summary: Deepfake speech detectors often output a single score without explaining why an audio sample is flagged, where in the signal the evidence lies, or what cues drive the decision. We propose an audio-native explainability pipeline using Integrated Gradients on time-aligned self-supervised representations to localize decision evidence over time. We apply the proposed method to three WavLM-based detectors (AASIST, CA-MHFA, SLS) on ASVspoof 5 and manually annotate the highest-attribution regions to provide a semantic meaning of the most important cues. Despite similar performance, the detectors rely on different cues: AASIST emphasizes non-speech/environment cues, CA-MHFA focuses on localized phoneme artifacts, and SLS relies on word boundaries and spectral integrity. We move beyond speculative reasoning and validate our findings by causal masking of the primary detector cues. Observed performance degradation further supports the explained detector semantics.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对深度伪造语音检测器缺乏可解释性的问题，提出了一种音频原生的可解释性分析管道。该管道基于集成梯度（Integrated Gradients）方法，并在时间对齐的自监督表示（WavLM）上应用，以定位决策证据在时间上的分布。作者将方法应用于三个基于WavLM的检测器（AASIST、CA-MHFA、SLS），并在ASVspoof 5数据集上进行实验。通过人工标注最高贡献区域，揭示了不同检测器依赖的不同线索：AASIST强调非语音/环境线索，CA-MHFA关注局部音素伪影，SLS则依赖于词语边界和频谱完整性。为了验证这些发现，作者进一步通过因果掩码移除主要检测线索，观察到性能下降，从而证实了解释的语义含义。该工作为深度伪造语音检测提供了可解释性分析框架，有助于理解检测模型的决策机制，提升模型可信度。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 安全从业者需要理解深度伪造语音检测器的决策依据，以提高对新型攻击的鲁棒性和可追溯性。本方法揭示了检测器的内部线索，有助于改进检测模型并规避攻击。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该可解释性方法可直接应用于主流深度伪造语音检测器的分析，未来可迁移至其他音频分类任务（如说话人识别、语音情感分析）中的模型解释。

items.title: RAT: Reference-Augmented Training for ASV Anti-Spoofing
items.summary: We introduce a spoofing countermeasure architecture conditioned on speaker-reference recordings, but observe that it converges to a solution that effectively ignores the reference during inference. Surprisingly, training with a reference channel induces invariance that improves deepfake detection, even when the reference is absent or mismatched during inference. Based on this observation, we propose a Reference-Augmented Training (RAT) strategy. RAT yields improved detection performance compared to single-utterance baselines, even when the reference recording is replaced with a zero vector at inference. Through rigorous analysis, we demonstrate that the optimization process rapidly diminishes the reference contributions, leading to inference largely independent of the reference channel. Using RAT, we achieve state-of-the-art 2.57% EER and 0.074 minDCF on the ASVspoof 5 benchmark with a single detector, surpassing even large ensemble systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自动说话人验证（ASV）反欺骗的参考增强训练（RAT）策略。传统的反欺骗系统仅基于单次语音输入进行检测，而本文尝试引入说话人参考录音作为条件，构建一个条件化的欺骗检测架构。然而，实验发现该架构在推理过程中会迅速收敛至忽略参考通道的解，即模型实际上并不依赖参考信息。令人惊讶的是，即使参考在推理时缺失或不匹配，训练过程中引入参考通道竟然诱导了某种不变性，从而提升了深度伪造检测性能。基于此观察，作者提出了RAT策略：在训练阶段仍然使用参考增强，但在推理阶段允许参考被替换为零向量。通过严格的实验分析，作者证明了优化过程使参考贡献迅速衰减，使得推理几乎独立于参考通道。在ASVspoof 5基准测试上，单个检测器使用RAT达到了2.57%的等错误率（EER）和0.074的最低检测代价函数（minDCF），超越了多个大型集成系统。这项工作揭示了参考增强训练的一种非直观收益，为ASV反欺骗提供了一种简单而有效的改进方法。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 针对自动说话人验证系统的深度伪造攻击日益严峻，该研究提出了一种无需增加推理复杂度的训练策略，显著提升了反欺骗性能，对语音生物识别安全具有直接实用价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于各类语音认证系统的反欺骗模块，提升对合成语音、重放攻击等深度伪造的检测能力，且易于集成到现有流程中。
